caption: This drawing depicts a piece of furniture, specifically a table, presented in two views: a front elevation on the left and a side elevation on the right. The front elevation shows a table with a semicircular top, with three legs visible—two positioned at the ends and one in the center—each leg is straight and tapers slightly downward. Rectangular sections are drawn on the front side, suggesting drawers or panels, with ornate oval details centered on the two vertical divisions. Measurements in inches are marked, including an overall width of 36 inches, with the leg spacings indicated as 11 1/8 inches on the left, 18 inches between legs, and 6 7/8 inches on the right. The side elevation on the right shows the table in profile, with a rectangular portion and the tabletop shown in an open, angled position. The overall height is marked as 27 1/2 inches and the depth as 18 inches. The drawing is composed of fine, precise black lines on a tan or off-white background, with some areas showing minor spots of discoloration or aging. The artist's name, "HARRY EISMAN," is printed in the bottom left corner.
title: Card Table
